protocol.json.purpose: Read-only baseline diagnosis: process vs exact CreateProcess primary-thread CPU/cycle intervals. No candidate timing/adoption or metric change.
protocol.json.runs: Same ROT N1280000000, two independent alternating A/A series with excluded1warmup+5 samples per engine. No retries/sample exclusions.
protocol.json.thread_identity: Capture primary TID returned by actual local Python3.14 _winapi.CreateProcess (verified implementation), query-only OpenThread; Toolhelp metadata filtered to target PID only at READY. No suspends/process mutations.
protocol.json.metrics: GetProcessTimes and GetThreadTimes kernel/user plus raw process/thread QueryCycleTime at existing interval reads; PID/TID/UTC. Sequential API reads not perfectly simultaneous; extra query overhead is recorded limitation.
protocol.json.monitoring: No PDH logger in this run. Prior PDH data is not contemporaneous evidence for this run.
protocol.json.limitations: Snapshot lists READY threads only; later new threads not enumerated. Raw cycle values not converted to frequency/time/instructions. Whole-run result not a replacement adoption benchmark.

scripts.run.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,datetime,hashlib
out=Path('.work/vm-thread-audit-20261116').resolve();rows=[]
for index in (1,2):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'worker.py'),'aa','rot','--series',str(index)]
 with (out/f'run-{index}.log').open('wb') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 rows.append({'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode});(out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');assert r.returncode==0
 value=json.loads((out/f'rot-aa-{index}.json').read_text());print('audit series',index,'CPU delta',value['aa_delta_percent'],flush=True)
(out/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'series':2,'primary_metric_or_OS_policy_changed':False},indent=2)+'\n')
